description: Communication builds the skills of listening, speaking, writing and presenting — from keeping a listening journal and giving a speech to reporting on a public meeting, teaching a lesson and running a program as master of ceremonies.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Observing communication
requirements.summary: One option for studying how you and others communicate.

children.title: Communication log
children.summary: Keeping a one-day log of the ways you communicate.

children.title: Listening journal
children.summary: Keeping a journal of listening experiences over several days.

children.title: Ways to communicate
children.summary: Listing ways to communicate and when each is ineffective.

requirements.title: Presenting yourself or an idea
requirements.summary: A creative description of yourself, or a pitch for a product or idea.

requirements.title: A speech
requirements.summary: Writing and giving a short speech to a group.

requirements.title: Introducing a speaker
requirements.summary: Interviewing someone and preparing an introduction of them as a guest speaker.

requirements.title: Reporting on a meeting
requirements.summary: Attending an approved public meeting with several viewpoints and writing an objective report.

requirements.title: Teaching a skill
requirements.summary: Planning and giving a lesson that teaches or informs, then checking that it worked.

requirements.title: Publishing
requirements.summary: One option: a letter to an editor, a web page or blog, or a printed newsletter, brochure or flyer.

requirements.title: Master of ceremonies
requirements.summary: Planning an approved troop event such as a court of honor or campfire program, writing the script and serving as master of ceremonies.

requirements.title: Communication careers
requirements.summary: Researching communication careers and the preparation one of them requires.
